content: Timeline A.1: 828/1425 he 'writes (or has copied)' R. al-Inzāliyya, R. Anjām, R. Bāʾiyya, R. Nuqṭa and R. Muḥammadiyya (with a query, 'in Yazd?'), and revises and expands the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ in company with Yazdī and other associates. The parenthesis is the dissertation's own caveat that a date may mark copying, not composition.
